content.title: Boston lawyer voted off 'Survivor' last night. Here's a recap
content.text: March 26, 2026, 9:43 a.m. ETSeason 50 of "Survivor" is officially underway, filled with new advantages, old rivalries and tear-filled challenges on the beach.In what promises to be the most competitive season ever, the milestone 50th season "In the Hands of the Fans" features returning all-star players and fan favorites, including three players from New England. However, after a double elimination in the fifth episode, only one contestant from New England remains in the competition.Here's a recap of who went home on "Survivor" on March 25.Who went home on 'Survivor' last night?In a double elimination, both Angelina Keeley of the Vatu tribe and Charlie Davis of the Cila tribe were voted off "Survivor" Season 50, Episode 5.Davis, a 27-year-old attorney who lives in Boston, went into this season ready to take more risks after placing second in Season 46, according to his cast bio. Ultimately, his tribe members voted him out because they felt he was untrustworthy and not strategic enough. Davis was the only contestant representing Massachusetts this season.Who is left on 'Survivor' Season 50?After the fifth episode, there are 17 contestants left on Season 50 of "Survivor," including one from New England – Aubry Bracco of Hampton Falls, New Hampshire. Here's a full list of remaining contestants:Aubry Bracco (Hampton Falls, NH) – Seasons 32, 34 and 38Rick Devens (Macon, GA) – Season 38Colby Donaldson (Austin, TX) – Seasons 2, 8 and 20Tiffany Ervin (Los Angeles, CA) – Season 46Cirie Fields (Jersey City, NJ) – Seasons 12, 16, 20 and 34Emily Flippen (Laurel, MD) – Season 45Chrissy Hofbeck (The Villages, FL) – Season 35Christian Hubicki (Tallahassee, FL) – Season 37Joseph "Joe" Hunter (West Sacramento, CA) – Season 48Kamilla Karthigesu (Foster City, CA) – Season 48Stephenie LaGrossa Kendrick (Dunedin, FL) – Seasons 10, 11 and 20Ozzy Lusth (Guanajuato, MX) – Seasons 13, 16, 23 and 34Genevieve Mushaluk (Winnipeg, MB) – Season 47Dee Valladares (Miami, FL) – Season 45Rizo Velovic (Yonkers, NY) – Season 49Benjamin "Coach" Wade (Susanville, CA) – Seasons 18, 20 and 23Jonathan Young (Gulf Shores, AL) – Season 42How to watch 'Survivor'Want to see how far the other New England contestants go? Season 50 of "Survivor" airs Wednesday at 8 p.m. on CBS.
